stem.en: The same rod is spun first about its centre, then about one end. What happens to its moment of inertia?
stem.et: Sama varrast pööratakse kõigepealt ümber keskme, siis ümber ühe otsa. Mis juhtub selle inertsimomendiga?

label.en: It is larger about the end, since more of the mass is then far from the axis
label.et: Ümber otsa on see suurem, sest siis on suurem osa massist teljest kaugel

label.en: It is unchanged — moment of inertia is a property of the rod alone
label.et: See ei muutu — inertsimoment on ainult varda enda omadus

label.en: It is larger about the centre, since the axis passes through the most mass there
label.et: Ümber keskme on see suurem, sest telg läbib seal kõige rohkem massi

label.en: It depends only on the rod's mass, which has not changed
label.et: See sõltub ainult varda massist, mis ei ole muutunud
